name: Genzou Gakuen Saint Mirage
original_name: 幻像学園セイントミラージュ
source:
An occult and erotic adventure game featuring members of the Occult Club who tackle incidents and mysteries within their school. 

The protagonists begin their investigation to unravel the mysteries of rumors circulating around the school, but a sinister force closes in on them... 

[Translated from [url=https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_gs0165/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
一款神秘和色情的冒险游戏，主角是神秘俱乐部的成员，他们要解决学校内的事件和谜团。

主角们开始调查，试图解开学校里流传的谣言之谜，但一股邪恶的力量却逼近了他们…… 

[译自[url=https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_gs0165/]DMM[/url]]
